card.name: Bible verse punctuation and 'once'
card.fires_on: Colons, dashes and digits inside Bible verse references (such as 1 John 1:8-9), and a few small words in religious prose like 'once', 'his' or 'themselves' before a following noun or phrase.

modes.label: Scripture references
modes.description: The colon, dash or verse number inside a chapter-and-verse citation after a book name.

modes.label: Small words in religious prose
modes.description: Words like once, his, themselves or a in sermon-style text, just before the phrase that completes the thought.
modes.example: the offering of the body of Jesus Christ<< once>> for all.

card.writes: Suppresses words about building and construction, with no clear promoted theme.
card.plain: It fires on the colons and dashes in Bible verse citations and on a few small words in sermon-style text.
